def move_one_ball(arr):
    if not arr:
        return True
    
    min_element = min(arr)
    min_index = arr.index(min_element)
    shifts_needed = len(arr) - min_index - 1
    
    return sorted(arr) == arr[-shifts_needed:] + arr[:-shifts_needed]
